title: Smith's full name
summary: He explains he was named Richard Charles Howard Smith to distinguish him among relatives.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well, I was born into the Smith clan. My name is Richard, and to make me different, they decided to name me Richard Charles Howard Smith. A lot of relatives got in the act there.
Well, that would be good for a trumpet player. You know, you get the Howard in there.
